Canopy MacroPad

Printed case, two layouts

Section

The cut face is filled solid, so a wall reads as a wall and not as a hole.

Case

Glass reads the inside with the lid shut, which is how it is assembled. Envelopes swaps the bare board slabs for the volumes build.py booleans against — sockets, connectors with a plug mated, buttons, the USB shell.

Explode

    Key colour = pane state

    Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset. Depth is resolved per pixel here, so the transparent keycaps and the case interior sort correctly — which the flat renders could not do.
